# LZMA SDK decoder (public domain)

`LzmaDec.c/.h`, `7zTypes.h`, `Compiler.h`, `Precomp.h`, `7zWindows.h` from the LZMA SDK by
Igor Pavlov (https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html; files taken unmodified from the official
github.com/ip7z/7zip repository, `C/`). The LZMA SDK is placed in the public domain.
Used by `src/formats/nsis.cpp` to unpack NSIS installers (the Gruntmods Edition installer).
